data.description:
## Incident Overview

When Strategy F (chunked review for large diffs) activates, the LLM sometimes produces malformed JSON. The schema correction budget is 2 attempts. When both fail, the runner exits with fail-closed: 'schema correction exhausted all 2 attempts -- synthetic schema_error present; blocking merge'. Additionally, code-reviewer-deep-verification returns non-JSON responses (108-113 bytes of prose) that exhaust the fallback chain.

**Observed on**: PRs #365, #372, #376, #379
**Impact**: Intermittent hard block on large PRs requiring admin bypass
data.title: ci-llm-review: schema correction budget of 2 exhausted on large diffs -> fail-closed merge block
